WeMM-Ecom-0.8B-GGUF

Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce

Evaluation · Quick Start · Best Practices

**WeMM-Ecom-0.8B-GGUF** is the GGUF edition of **WeMM-Ecom-0.8B**, developed by **WeChat Vision, Tencent**. It pairs **Q4_K_M** language-model weights with an **F16 multimodal projector** for deployment with **llama.cpp** and supports **hybrid thinking**. The WeMM-Ecom family delivers leading e-commerce performance, with WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B outperforming open-source models with hundreds of billions of parameters. Across model sizes, it also maintains general-purpose capabilities on par with state-of-the-art models of comparable size. ## Highlights The highlights and benchmark figures summarize the corresponding **WeMM-Ecom-0.8B** family checkpoint. - **E-commerce understanding:** Outperforms Qwen3.5-0.8B by **16.43 points** and MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B by **13.03 points** in average benchmark score. - **Broad general capabilities:** Outperforms Qwen3.5-0.8B by **6.93 points** and MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B by **1.09 points** in average benchmark score. - **GGUF deployment:** Q4_K_M language-model weights and an F16 projector, with command-line inference and an OpenAI-compatible local server. ## Model Overview - **Architecture:** 0.8B dense model. - **Language-model quantization:** Q4_K_M. - **Multimodal projector:** F16 GGUF. - **Context window:** 262,144 tokens. **GGUF family:** [0.8B](https://huggingface.co/tencent/WeMM-Ecom-0.8B-GGUF) · [2B](https://huggingface.co/tencent/WeMM-Ecom-2B-GGUF) · [4B](https://huggingface.co/tencent/WeMM-Ecom-4B-GGUF) · [9B](https://huggingface.co/tencent/WeMM-Ecom-9B-GGUF) · [35B-A3B](https://huggingface.co/tencent/WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B-GGUF) **More formats:** [BF16](https://huggingface.co/tencent/WeMM-Ecom-0.8B) · [FP8](https://huggingface.co/tencent/WeMM-Ecom-0.8B-FP8) · [GPTQ](https://huggingface.co/tencent/WeMM-Ecom-0.8B-GPTQ) ## Family Evaluation The following comparisons report the **WeMM-Ecom-0.8B** family checkpoint, following the technical report: **28 e-commerce benchmarks across eight scenarios** and **64 general benchmarks across eight categories**. Scores use a 0–100 scale. ### E-commerce Benchmarks The suite covers product attributes, moderation, OCR, retrieval, grounding, reasoning, public e-commerce benchmarks, and product knowledge. ![WeMM-Ecom-0.8B e-commerce comparisons](assets/ecommerce-benchmarks.png)
